title.en: Microsoft releases MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming and two MAI voice models
title.zhHans: 微软发布 MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming 与两款 MAI 语音模型

searchSummary.en: Microsoft released MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for incremental real-time transcription in 60 languages alongside MAI-Voice-2.1 and MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash.
searchSummary.zhHans: 微软发布 MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming，支持 60 种语言的增量实时转录，并同时推出 MAI-Voice-2.1 与 MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash。

summary.en: Microsoft released MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for incremental real-time transcription in 60 languages alongside MAI-Voice-2.1 and MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash.
summary.zhHans: 微软发布 MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming，支持 60 种语言的增量实时转录，并同时推出 MAI-Voice-2.1 与 MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash。

narrative.en: The release adds an explicitly streaming transcription workflow to Microsoft’s in-house model lineup. Reported ranking and latency figures remain tied to vendor or launch-time measurements, and no qualifying external production adoption was established.
narrative.zhHans: 该发布为微软自研模型系列增加了明确的流式转录工作流。排名和延迟数据仍来自厂商或发布期测量，尚未证明符合门槛的外部生产采用。

text.en: Microsoft released MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming with continuous language detection across 60 languages.
text.zhHans: 微软发布 MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming，支持 60 种语言的连续自动语言检测。

text.en: Latency and ranking claims do not guarantee deployed end-to-end voice-agent performance.
text.zhHans: 延迟与排名主张不能保证实际部署中语音智能体的端到端性能。
